images.author: Cz4523
images.why: 4096×3072 photograph of the completed tower in July 2025; recognisable curved crown and diagonal structure against blue sky. Landscape original requires a portrait crop.

images.author: EditQ
images.why: 3000×4000 photograph in native 3:4 portrait orientation; strong resolution for a full-bleed card showing the tower within Nanning’s business district.

images.author: EditQ
images.why: 1264×2248 portrait photograph specifically isolating the tower. Meets the preferred long-side resolution, but its narrow framing limits a full-height 3:4 crop.

images.author: Ryedamien
images.why: Clearly identified portrait photograph of IFC T1 with its neighbouring tower. Fallback only: 515×916 pixels, below the preferred resolution, and photographed during construction in 2019.

images.author: Mohamed Ouda
images.why: 3586×1422 real photograph from June 2023 showing the tower and surrounding district. Wide composition needs substantial cropping; a 3:4 crop retains at most 1422 pixels vertically.

images.author: Mohamed Ouda
images.why: 3213×1729 daylight photograph from April 2022. Alternative construction-era view with more vertical resolution than the 2023 panorama; requires a substantial portrait crop.

images.author: Dinkun Chen
images.why: 8192×5464 Canon EOS R5 photograph from Shenzhen Talents Park; ample resolution and surrounding space for a custom 3:4 crop. Shows the tower before completion in December 2024.

images.author: Dinkun Chen; crop by JeyReydar97
images.why: 2766×4191 portrait extraction of the preceding photograph, already focused on the headquarters tower. Convenient framing alternative, not a separate photographic angle.

images.author: Lhzss8
images.why: 966×2209 photograph from March 2026 documenting the completed headquarters. More recent alternative, although the very narrow framing compromises full-height 3:4 use.
